name: Astron Energy Bursary 2027
whoItsFor: South African citizens under 35, with at least a 70% average; fields include engineering, IT, computer science, finance, accounting, commerce and data analytics.
documents: Certified ID documents of parents or guardians
Proof of other bursary or NSFAS funding where applicable
Certified academic records and registration proof where applicable
notes: Closes 12:00 midday on Monday 26 Oct 2026; several bursary listing sites agree on this date. Applications are online and the bursary is administered by Excel@Uni. We have not found an official Astron Energy page, so no link is shown. Listed fields differ between sites; check the application portal before applying.

name: NSFAS 2027
whoItsFor: Students at public universities and TVET colleges who qualify financially.
documents: Declaration or disability forms where applicable
Orphan and vulnerable child form where applicable
notes: The 2027 closing date is 31 Oct 2026, as reported after the Minister confirmed it on 22 Sep and NSFAS said there will be no extension. An earlier announcement gave 18 Nov, so confirm on the myNSFAS portal. TVET college admissions for 2027 closed on 30 Sep 2026.

name: ISFAP Bursary 2027
whoItsFor: First-year undergraduates in 2027 from households earning R600,000 a year or less, accepted at a partner university, in selected fields.
documents: Signed ISFAP funding application consent form
Certified ID documents of parents, guardians and household earners
notes: Fields and partner universities change yearly. Confirm the portal status before applying.

name: DSTI-NRF Postgraduate Scholarships
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Honours, Master's, PhD). South African citizens and permanent residents with at least 65% in their previous degree. Age limits apply: 28 for Honours, 30 for Master's, 32 for PhD.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Reported: full cost of study for financially needy students (household income up to R350,000 a year) or students with disabilities, and partial cost for other qualifying candidates. Applications go through the NRF. Details come from a summary and have not been checked against the funder's own page yet; confirm the closing date and rules before applying.

name: UNISA Postgraduate Bursaries
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Postgraduate Diploma, Honours, Master's, Doctoral). Mainly South African citizens registered at UNISA. Students moving from an undergraduate degree into Honours need a 60% average.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Reported: tuition fees for Postgraduate Diploma and Honours students; Master's and doctoral students may also get research allowances. The source says "temporarily registered" students; confirm with UNISA what that means. Details come from a summary and have not been checked against the funder's own page yet; confirm the closing date and rules before applying.

name: IDC External Bursary Scheme
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Honours and postgraduate CTA). Unemployed South African citizens with financial need, studying Law, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science or Accounting.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Reported: tuition, accommodation, meals, transport and a once-off laptop allowance. Details come from a summary and have not been checked against the funder's own page yet; confirm the closing date and rules before applying.

name: SANSA Postgraduate Bursary
whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Honours, Master's, Doctoral). South African citizens studying relevant science and engineering qualifications, with an average of at least 65%.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Reported: fixed yearly funding limits that differ by level (Honours, Master's, Doctoral). Details come from a summary and have not been checked against the funder's own page yet; confirm the closing date and rules before applying.

whoItsFor: Postgraduate only (Master's and PhD). Nationals of eligible Southern African countries studying in South Africa, in justice (climate justice, law, economics, politics), education policy or humanities.
documents: Documents listed on the official application page
notes: Reported: support for up to two years, with the option to reapply for a third year depending on performance. Details come from a summary and have not been checked against the funder's own page yet; confirm the closing date and rules before applying.
